::: {.workshop-intro}
This workshop follows the path from first login to a submitted R job. The five modules can be presented live and remain available afterward as a practical reference.

**Audience:** Researchers who are new to Longleaf or shared computing clusters  
**Format:** Five short modules with demonstrations and reusable examples
:::
